GROUND STATION · PROVIDER SETTINGS

Power up the globe

The globe has keyless feeds; no key is required to start. Each row shows the provider’s current free allowance, restrictions, or billing risk. Saving a key does not itself start usage, but turning on its feature can consume your provider allowance or cost money. In Mulch Garden, keys are encrypted and tied to your account. Google Maps and Cesium ion keys are used in your browser, so restrict them to this website. Other keys stay on the server. Some feeds are not connected to account-isolated Cloudflare routes yet.

Check quotas before enabling paid services · ESC to close

Optional keys are your choice. Google requires billing for photorealistic tiles; OpenAI is usage-billed. Keep both blank to keep those services off.
